links.outcome: Model performance under cross-validation versus external validation on a new dataset
links.effect: In cross-validation predicted and real values were linearly dependent; in external validation predicted values were not related to real ones, probably only through an average value.
links.quote: The results show that, in the cross-validation, the predicted and the real values are linearly dependent, while in the external validation, the predicted values are not related to the real ones, but probably just through an average value.
